verdict.what_is_wrong: From 03:26:57 to 03:27:11 UTC, python3 (PID 11125) in one container was runnable but repeatedly unable to get CPU time, with its execution pinned near a roughly 0.25-core ceiling. The 100 ms periodic ceiling, long runnable waits, and idle CPUs make a container CPU quota the best explanation; the quota itself is not directly recorded, so this is an inference rather than a directly observed setting.
